articles.headline: Deputy Health Minister inspects infectious disease surveillance and testing at Yangon International Airport
articles.headlineJa: 保健副大臣がヤンゴン国際空港の感染症監視と検査を視察
articles.summary: The Deputy Minister of Health inspected the surveillance of infectious diseases that could pose a public health emergency, including Nipah virus, at Yangon International Airport, the Ministry of Health announced.
articles.summaryOriginal: The Deputy Minister of Health inspected the surveillance of infectious diseases that could pose a public health emergency, including Nipah virus, at Yangon International Airport, the Ministry of Health announced.
articles.summaryJa: 保健省の発表によると、保健副大臣はヤンゴン国際空港でニパウイルスを含む公衆衛生上の緊急事態を引き起こす可能性のある感染症の監視を視察した。

articles.headline: Myanmar says no Nipah Virus cases detected, warns against online misinformation
articles.headlineJa: ミャンマー、ニパウイルス感染者は検出されていないと発表、オンラインの誤った情報に警告
articles.summary: Myanmar’s Ministry of Health said on Tuesday that no cases of Nipah virus infection have been detected in the country and warned the public against believing misinformation circulating on social media. In a statement, the ministry said Nipah virus has never previously been reported in Myanmar and that no suspected or confirmed cases have been identified to date. articles.headline: Health Ministry says Nipah Virus detected in neighboring countries but not yet in Myanmar
articles.headlineJa: 保健省はニパウイルスが近隣諸国で検出されたがミャンマーではまだ検出されていないと発表
articles.summary: The Ministry of Health has announced that although the bat-borne Nipah virus has been detected in neighboring countries, no cases have been found in Myanmar to date. articles.headline: Subclade K influenza virus not detected in Myanmar, public urged not to panic
articles.headlineJa: サブクレードK型インフルエンザウイルスはミャンマーでは検出されず、国民はパニックに陥らないよう呼びかけ
articles.summary: The Ministry of Health has announced that the Subclade K virus, which has been reported in 34 countries worldwide, has not yet been detected in Myanmar. articles.headline: Fire Department conducts high-rise fire response drill at Times City
articles.headlineJa: 消防署、タイムズシティで高層火災対応訓練を実施
articles.summary: Myanmar’s Fire Services Department conducted a high-rise fire response simulation at Times City on December 5, aiming to strengthen rapid emergency response capabilities in the event of a fire outbreak in high-rise buildings. According to reports, the exercise was carried out to ensure swift and effective action in situations such as natural disasters, accidents caused by negligence of occupants, or any other incident that could trigger a fire in high-rise complexes like Times City. articles.summaryJa: ミャンマー消防局は12月5日、高層ビル火災発生時の迅速な緊急対応能力の強化を目的に、タイムズシティで高層火災対応シミュレーションを実施した。報道によると、この訓練は、自然災害、居住者の過失による事故、タイムズシティのような高層複合施設で火災を引き起こす可能性のあるその他の事件などの状況において、迅速かつ効果的な行動を確保するために実施されたという。この訓練は、同省の特別捜索救助部隊のメンバーによって共同で実施されました。

articles.headline: Yangon Region leads in COVID loan disbursement and outstanding debt; borrowers required to repay by March 2026
articles.headlineJa: ヤンゴン地域は新型コロナウイルス融資実行額と債務残高で首位。借り手は2026年3月までに返済する必要がある
articles.summary: Yangon Region is the region with the largest amount of COVID loans and the largest amount of outstanding repayments, and those who have borrowed money need to repay them by March 2026, said Yangon Region Chief Minister U Soe Thein said at a meeting held at Mingalar Hall, Union of Myanmar Federation of Chambers of Commerce and Industry (UMFCCI), located on Min Ye Kyaw Swar Street, Yangon, to ensure the fastest recovery of loans from companies and entrepreneurs who have borrowed 20 million kyats and above from the COVID-19 fund.
articles.summaryOriginal: Yangon Region is the region with the largest amount of COVID loans and the largest amount of outstanding repayments, and those who have borrowed money need to repay them by March 2026, said Yangon Region Chief Minister U Soe Thein said at a meeting held at Mingalar Hall, Union of Myanmar Federation of Chambers of Commerce and Industry (UMFCCI), located on Min Ye Kyaw Swar Street, Yangon, to ensure the fastest recovery of loans from companies and entrepreneurs who have borrowed 20 million kyats and above from the COVID-19 fund.
articles.summaryJa: ヤンゴン管区は新型コロナウイルス融資が最も多く、返済残高も最も多い地域であり、借り入れ者は2026年3月までに返済する必要があると、ヤンゴン管区ミンイェチョー・スワル通りにあるミャンマー商工会議所連合会（UMFCCI）ミンガラーホールで開催された会議で、2,000万チャットを借り入れた企業や起業家からの融資を最速で回収できるようにするため、ヤンゴン管区のウ・ソエ・テイン首相は述べた。上記は新型コロナウイルス感染症基金からのもの。

articles.headline: Myanmar expands HPV vaccination to protect more girls from cervical cancer
articles.headlineJa: ミャンマー、より多くの少女を子宮頸がんから守るためHPVワクチン接種を拡大
articles.summary: The Ministry of Health announced that cervical cancer vaccination can reduce the rate of HPV infection — the virus that causes cervical cancer — by up to 83% among girls aged 13 to 19, and lower early-stage cancer cases by 31% among girls aged 15 to 19. At a coordination meeting on November 10 in Nay Pyi Taw, Union Minister Prof. Dr. Thet Khaing Win highlighted that cervical cancer is the fourth most common cancer among women globally, and the third most common in developing countries. articles.summaryJa: 保健省は、子宮頸がんワクチン接種により、13歳から19歳の女子のHPV感染率（子宮頸がんの原因ウイルス）を最大83％減少させることができ、15歳から19歳の女子の初期がん発症率を31％減少させることができると発表しました。11月10日にネピドーで開催された調整会議で、連合大臣のテット・カイン・ウィン教授は、子宮頸がんが4番目であることを強調しました。世界中の女性の間で最も一般的ながんであり、発展途上国では 3 番目に多いがんです。子宮頸がん症例の約 70% は、現在のワクチンに含まれる HPV 16 型および 18 型によって引き起こされます。

articles.headline: Deputy Minister for Health says over 120,000 malaria patients detected and treated from January to August 2025
articles.headlineJa: 保健副大臣は、2025年1月から8月までに12万人以上のマラリア患者が発見され治療されたと発表
articles.summary: A total of 126,562 malaria cases were diagnosed and treated in the eight months from January to August 2025, said Deputy Minister for Health Dr Aye Tun.
articles.summaryOriginal: A total of 126,562 malaria cases were diagnosed and treated in the eight months from January to August 2025, said Deputy Minister for Health Dr Aye Tun.
articles.summaryJa: 保健副大臣のエー・トゥン博士は、2025年1月から8月までの8か月間で合計126,562人のマラリア症例が診断され治療されたと述べた。
